note: This cross-check maps a build-maturity code and an environment code onto an approximate TRL. It is a tailored aid created for this tool (BUILD_SPEC D-2.1), not an agency standard, and it never overrides the screening answers. It exists only to flag internal inconsistency.

environments.label: Analysis only — no physical test
environments.help: Paper studies, simulation or modelling only. Nothing has been exercised in hardware or with real data.

environments.label: Laboratory environment
environments.help: Bench or laboratory conditions, chosen for convenience of measurement rather than to reproduce the deployment. DoD Table 2-3 calls a laboratory breadboard test “low fidelity” compared with the eventual system.

environments.label: Relevant / simulated operational environment
environments.help: A testing environment that simulates both the most important and most stressing aspects of the operational environment (DoD TRA Guidebook, Table 2-3, p. 11). Examples: high-fidelity laboratory integration, wave tank, environmental chamber, seawater immersion rig.

environments.label: Operational environment — limited duration or scope
environments.help: The real deployment environment, but for a short deployment, in a favourable season, or with only part of the mission profile exercised.

environments.label: Operational environment — full mission range
environments.help: The real deployment environment across the full spectrum of expected employments and conditions, including stressing cases.

builds.label: Concept / analysis only
builds.help: No hardware or code beyond models, drawings and analysis.

builds.label: Breadboard / immature proof-of-concept
builds.help: Integrated components that represent the system well enough to determine concept feasibility; may resemble the final system in function only (DoD Table 2-3, p. 11).

builds.label: Component prototype (alpha/beta)
builds.help: A stand-alone component or module prototype, tested on its own or with simulated interfaces.

builds.label: System prototype, partially integrated
builds.help: A system-level prototype partially integrated with the existing systems it must work with.

builds.label: Near-production-quality system prototype
builds.help: At or near full scale, most functions available, built largely from production-intended parts.

builds.label: Final-form system (qualified)
builds.help: The actual system in its final form, completed and qualified through test and demonstration.
